title: Personal Sender Account Terms — One Account per Customer
content:
**Clause.** Each customer may hold at most 1 Personal Sender Account, counted by customer profile, never by name or phone number. An application may be opened only when the customer holds no other Personal Sender Account whose status is anything other than closed. A customer whose earlier account was closed by a compliance termination may not open a new account. An account closed at the customer's own request, or an application closed without activation because verification failed, does not block a new application. A Paloma Business account is a separate contract and never counts toward this cap: business sending runs on the business account and personal sending on the Personal Sender Account.

## Conditions for a new application

| What the customer profile already shows | New Personal Sender Account application |
|---|---|
| No Personal Sender Account at all | may be opened |
| A Personal Sender Account pending verification, active, locked, restricted or suspended | may not be opened |
| Only closed accounts, closed at the customer's own request | may be opened |
| Only closed applications, closed without activation because verification failed | may be opened |
| An earlier account closed by a compliance termination | may not be opened |
| A Paloma Business account (in addition to any of the above) | does not change the answer |

## Basis of the judgement

- **Counted by profile.** The count is taken on the customer profile in Paloma's records. Two profiles with the same name or the same phone number are not merged for this count, and one profile is not split by them.
- **Records, not statements.** Whether another account is open, and how an earlier account was closed, is read from the account records of that customer profile.
- **Termination is final.** A closure by compliance termination blocks a new application whatever else the profile shows.

## Hypothetical cases

1. A profile holds one Personal Sender Account in status locked. A second application on that profile may not be opened: a locked account is not closed.
2. A profile holds one account closed at the customer's request and one Paloma Business account. A new Personal Sender Account application may be opened: the closed account does not block it and the business account never counts.
